function: Symbol detection in uplink MIMO by the data-driven ChannelNet detector (MLPs and CNNs), simplified with product-quantization approximate matrix multiplication (MADDNESS) to cut complexity (pp. 1-3).
system: Uplink MIMO: BS with 32 or 64 antennas, 16 or 32 single-antenna users, 16-QAM, no RIS; band not stated (pp. 2, 4).
method: ChannelNet: iterative MLP/CNN detector with softmax symbol output, trained with Adam, 600 epochs (supervised, implied); MADDNESS (regression-tree prototypes, lookup tables) then replaces matrix multiplications (pp. 2-4).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rayleigh CN(0,1) channels (MLP variant) and exponentially correlated channels, r = 0.6 (Conv variant); 2e6 samples per epoch; imperfect CSI also tested (p. 4).
test_conditions: Same simulated channel family for training and testing; two sizes (32x16, 64x32) at r = 0.6; imperfect-CSI curves; no unseen-condition test reported (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: MMSE. Learned: ChannelNet [9] (exact, 10/15 iterations, MLP version) and 8-bit weight quantization of [13] on ChannelNet; other learned detectors only cited (pp. 4-5).
metrics: SER versus SNR (14-19 dB); accumulated loss in dB at SER 1e-2; ratio of computational complexity to exact multiplication; storage in MB (pp. 4-5, Figs. 2-4).
complexity: Per input vector: CP comparisons, CM lookups, integer additions versus LCM FP operations; 40% (32x16) or 50% (64x32) of exact cost; storage 3-6 MB (pp. 3-4).
q1_support: p. 4: "Rt and Rr are generated from the exponential correlation model [12]." Own Kronecker-type simulator with Rayleigh U (p. 4); no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "The correlation coefficient r is set as 0.6 in all following cases." Two sizes (32x16, 64x32) and imperfect-CSI curves are reported, but no model is tested on a size, correlation, or channel type not used in training; a CSI-error test does not count.
q3_support: p. 4: "The method of quantizing weight matrices in [13] is used as the baseline". p. 5: "all tested ChannelNet detectors exhibit superior performance compared to the MMSE detectors" (Figs. 3-4 plot SER of ChannelNet, 8-bit-Conv-20, and MMSE).
q4_support: p. 3: "the encoding procedure needs CP comparisons to determine its indices". p. 4: "complexity of the ChannelNet-Conv-20 is reduced to 40% of the original"; operation counts per layer and Table I ratios are also given (p. 4).
q5_support: p. 4: "Simulations are conducted for two MIMO systems with configurations Nr = 32, Nt = 16 and Nr = 64, Nt = 32." The data come from the authors' own channel simulator; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset or measurements.
notes: Included in area 1: the work simplifies the trained ChannelNet MIMO detector with product quantization (MADDNESS); the learned detector performs the symbol detection and the simplified version is evaluated by SER (Figs. 3-4). No RIS. Table I and Figs. 2-4 (pp. 4-5) were read from page images because the text extraction omits them. q3 is borderline: the learned comparisons are ChannelNet [9] (earlier paper, shared author) and the 8-bit quantization baseline [13], which the reviewer may judge to be variants of the proposed simplification; the non-learned baseline is MMSE (Figs. 3-4). q2: the paper does not say whether one trained network serves both sizes.
